title: Classes
explain: A class bundles fields and methods, and `new` creates an object from it. Make fields `private` and expose behavior through methods so the object controls its own state. A constructor runs when the object is created and sets up its fields.
exercise: Add a `withdraw` method that refuses to go below zero and returns whether it worked.
tip: Public fields let any code put an object into an invalid state. Keep fields private and validate inside methods.
